items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And there was Johnny, Elmer Williams on tenor

ctx.x: And there was Johnny, Elmer Williams on tenor, Bobby Stark on... Yeah, two brass. Bobby and Slats on trombone. I was thinking that Chick had another trumpet, but he didn't have another trumpet until I went in the band, and I worked with Chick... Which wasn't long, because he didn't work much. I think we had a ten-day engagement up in New England, ten one-nighters, you know. And I worked them with him. That's when he was enlarging his band. And when
